snippet.title: Pluralys - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Pluralys will be available in Early Access on November 28:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275440/Pluralys/

You play as Elie, a 16-year-old teenager, curious and dreamy, living a peaceful life in Sector G with his mother, little sister, and his two best friends: Gab and Medie.
But everything changes when a mysterious figure named Farahn reaches out to you:
"You are the only one who can change the course of things."

Dive into our narrative adventure: explore, connect with others, bend time, and discover a universe filled with mysteries, humor, and extraterrestrials.

Follow us on social media:
https://linktr.ee/pluralys

#pluralys #indiegame #cozygames #rpg #steam
